claim_scope: One historically exposed search sequence, not three independent replications or general recursive improvement.
read_boundary: All registered members of a stage must finalize and have one official score; no partial read.
proposal_budget_notes: Both branches use identical limits. Output is an acceptance target, not a provider-enforced generation cap; over-budget or unmetered proposals consume their opportunity and are rejected without replacement. Report actual compute. Four contacts per proposal include all artifact-tool continuations. No hidden tools, prior conversation, previous_response_id or API-key spend.
